records.rationale: In `scheduleEmailReminders.ts`, inside the `for (const reminder of remindersToCancel)` loop, the code creates Prisma delete promises (`prisma.workflowReminder.delete(...)`) and stores them in `workflowRemindersToDelete`, but doesn’t attach a handler until after the loop (`await Promise.all(workflowRemindersToDelete)`). Because the loop also does `await client.request(...)` on each iteration before reaching `Promise.all`, any delete promise that rejects could sit without a handler across one or more `await` boundaries, which is a known “footgun” (potential unhandled rejection / late-handling).
